description.html: This 100x45x45 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 202.5 liters is made from glass of the right thickness for its size. The back panel is LAKOBEL glass, and the outer sides are covered with decorative film you choose when ordering: wood, bamboo, marble, black or white.

The horizontal layout with 100 cm of length gives a floor area where a basking zone, a cool zone and a hiding area are easy to arrange. Reptile thermoregulation depends on being able to move between warm and cool zones inside the terrarium. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
